provenance.dimension_basis: ACP AMSO specification 20271801, US customary dimensions; AMSO22/35 share exterior envelope; power variant not resolved visually
provenance.hidden_structure: hinge and latch internal dimensions inferred; no OEM service geometry asserted

findings: Principal rotary-control AMSO maintained across source photographs, demonstration shots and partial food-loading shots.
Closing and opening motion follow the observed source frames; post-closing LCD remains DoorOpen before Ready3231.
Final decoded paired streams manually compared for main body/window, cavity/shelf, controls, partial shots and intermediate door state.
Native Blender camera projection checked on four cavity points in all996 final timeline frames; native door angles checked on every frame.

motion_fit.method: Joint fit of three unoccluded stationary cavity mouth corners manually re-observed (lower-right is obscured by open door support / frame crop and omitted from fit) at3346 and five source right-handle endpoints. Camera pose/focal and observed positive X door angles optimized together; original per-frame static-body SIFT affine retained.
motion_fit.uncertainty: Occluded latch/hinge internal geometry and approximate physical dimensions are visual estimates; no force simulation.

excluded_cavity_corner.reason: Lower-right nominal aperture corner is obscured by door support and below/near the frame boundary; the provisional [513,443] is not used as a measured landmark. Its residual is retained transparently but is not a fit constraint.

native_projection.basis: Independent world_to_camera_view against per-source K/matrix, four static cavity corners on every final editable timeline frame; native door rotation checked against render plan. This verifies camera/animation implementation, not image-identical geometry.

limitations: Principal microwave only; people, food, vessels, source backgrounds and editorial titles omitted.
Physical family dimensions follow source documentation; hidden hinge/stay details, sheet thicknesses, local handle shape and exact serial/power variant remain estimates.

Per-frame source indices and independent native camera equivalence verify implementation. Landmark fits and interpolated camera registration do not prove pixel-identical shape, materials or perspective.

Opening lower-right cavity corner is obscured/cropped and was excluded from the joint fit. Only three visible cavity corners and five observed handle points constrain that shot; residual silhouette differences remain.
LCD uses native green text with observed readable states; pixel refresh transitions, reflections and font glyph detail are simplified.
Sampled structural clearance is separate from dynamics. No force simulation or continuous-time collision certificate is claimed.
